outcome.description: Typed visual result consumed by the content Skill.

generator.description: Image-generation mechanism used for the artifact, or null when no image is needed.

imageRef.description: Generated image reference, or null when unavailable or disabled.

promptRef.description: Exact saved generation prompt reference, or null when disabled.

claimRefs.description: Frozen brief claims encoded in the visual.

inspection.description: Deterministic visual inspection result before final independent review.

evidenceRefs.description: Exact image, prompt, and inspection evidence references.

reason.description: Bounded blocker or not-needed reason, otherwise null.
